comment_regular: Verified QueuedTreeModel vtable QueueMe override (+0x20). If the tree's icon texture name exists, it builds the TESIconTree default-path + texture name and schedules/reuses it as a child texture dependency, then hands off to the queued-model base path. Fallout's named QueuedTreeModel::QueueMe follows the same icon-texture then base-model queue pattern.
